chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text:
Overview
This fee structure covers BTech tuition, showing the current fiscal year's fee along with recent years for reference, and separate rates for Nepalese and international students. The current fiscal year is 2082/83.

chunks.heading: Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2082/83 (Current Fee)
chunks.text:
Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2082/83 (Current Fee)
The current BTech fee for the 2082/83 fiscal year is Rs 9,60,000.

chunks.heading: Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2081/82
chunks.text:
Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2081/82
The BTech fee for the 2081/82 fiscal year was Rs 9,15,000.

chunks.heading: Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2079/80
chunks.text:
Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2079/80
The BTech fee for the 2079/80 fiscal year was Rs 8,50,000.

chunks.heading: Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2078/79
chunks.text:
Fee Structure for Nepalese Students > Fiscal Year 2078/79
The BTech fee for the 2078/79 fiscal year was Rs 8,00,000.

chunks.heading: Fee Structure for International Students > SAARC Countries
chunks.text:
Fee Structure for International Students > SAARC Countries
Applicants from SAARC countries pay 1.5 times the fee charged to domestic (Nepalese) students.

chunks.heading: Fee Structure for International Students > Non-SAARC Countries
chunks.text:
Fee Structure for International Students > Non-SAARC Countries
Applicants from countries outside SAARC pay double the fee charged to domestic (Nepalese) students.
